exact_statement: For each rooted singleton-leaf partition tree T of [N] with 2 or 3 children per internal vertex, L_T(S)=1+sum_v b_v*1{S intersects C_v} is the length of an all-subset prefix code, max L_T<=3N-2, and H(f)<=Gamma_T(f)=sum_S fhat(S)^2 L_T(S). If Boolean f,g differ on input fraction rho, sqrt(Gamma_T(f))<=sqrt(Gamma_T(g))+2 sqrt(rho max L_T), and |I(f)-I(g)|<=2N rho. For complete depth-d ternary recursive majority g_d, d>=1, padded to N>=3^d bits, the explicit main/padding tree satisfies Gamma_T(g_d)<=6I(g_d)-3. Every truth-table edit f of this g_d satisfies Gamma_T(f)<=12I(f)-6+48N rho-16rho; in particular H(f)<=Gamma_T(f)<=12I(f) if N rho<=1/8. Every one-point edit satisfies H(f)<=Gamma_T(f)<=25I(f), and <=12I(f) for N>=6. For fixed d the code-cost difference under padding and one-point editing tends to zero.
hypotheses: Uniform finite sign cube; actual Boolean f,g.
Entropy and code lengths in bits; I=sum_S |S| fhat(S)^2.
Tree and ordered child cells fixed for the source, not chosen after observing S.
Singleton leaves, no unary vertices, internal arity 2 or 3.
Family conclusions require d>=1, N>=3^d, complete ternary recursive majority base and Boolean flips on D.
No arbitrary unpaid Boolean terminal is included in the family.
